title: Mohammad Eslami, Head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran: "The fact that the US president constantly threatens to attack Mount Kolang [Pickaxe], and has previously used various forms of rhetoric and threats regarding attacks on other locations, is a clear indication of their desperation. At the same time, the Director General of the IAEA, who, in our view, and as the course of history has demonstrated, is acting as an agent and a compliant follower of our adversary, seeks to come and inspect sites of interest to our enemy, effectively providing them with information about what is and is not there. It is clear that these two issues are inextricably linked. This amounts to an abuse of the mandate of international institutions and undermines their legitimacy. It also exposes a serious vulnerability in both the UN Charter and the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT). The application of such double standards is entirely condemnable. These double standards have become so blatant that they are now being applied openly.

" Mohammad Eslami, Head of the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran: "Whether Iran withdraws from the NPT is a major strategic decision that falls within the country's sovereign authority. It is not for me to answer that question. What is important, however, is that our country makes its decisions within a broader strategic framework, guided by its national security considerations and national interests.
